title: Revolt of the Pitauds
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Revolt of the Pitauds", at revision 1366200720, opens: "The revolt of the pitauds was a French peasants' revolt in the mid-16th century." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3157839, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "French peasant riots over salt taxes". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
